stem: A room's daily-average temperature is within the supplied range, but the trend chart shows a repeated 90-minute high-temperature event after lights-on. What is the best technician interpretation?
choices: The room was fully acceptable because the daily average is normal
The repeated excursion should be documented because averages can hide biologically meaningful short-term events
The trend chart should be deleted so the average is easier to read
Only nighttime data should be reviewed
rationale: Averages can hide repeated peaks and transitions. Logged time-series data should be used to identify duration and timing of meaningful excursions.
